svg.text: Network organization and the components inside a DSA attention module
DSA attention is expanded in panel B →
append the current token's K and V
Index sweep over all visible keys
QI · KI → scale → ReLU → weighted head sum
one shared selection set per query
Each transformer block: RMSNorm → Attention → residual add → RMSNorm → FFN → residual add
The 16 indexer heads are separate from the 64 main attention heads. FFN: MoE, with a dense first-layer exception.
